policy: Every trust-kernel domain maps to exactly one of five accountable owners (design §19). An owner may evolve implementation inside its boundary, but cannot change a protocol or invariant without a versioned decision and a migration (design §20). Validated by server/src/trust-kernel/observability/ownership.ts and the observability contract test.

domains.summary: Actor resolution, verified action context, JWT/membership, RLS, tenant/site scoping (migrations 0180).
Managed signer ports and key-id custody; the application stores key ids only, never private keys (design §11.2).
Trust bundle issuance, trust-root pinning, freshness/checkpoint policy (migration 0183).
Working/release lifecycle, four-eyes separation of duties, freeze/approve/release authority (migration 0182).
Warning-exception grants, safety revocation, VOID handling (migrations 0181, 0182).
Operation vocabulary, dialect defense-in-depth, machine parameter ranges.
Signed machine-profile attestation, tool/postprocessor binding, capability compiler.
Deterministic FactoryPacket V3 bytes, canonical JSON, fixed ZIP profile, golden vectors.
Private artifact quarantine store, outbox/worker materialization, P2 containment.
tools/factory-packet-verifier: independent offline packet/trust verification, no builder imports.
Mutation/hostile packet corpus and the negative-vector conformance suite.
Signed evidence manifest + EvidenceAttestationV1 with a separate evidence key (design §16.4).

Repair Intelligence Phase 0 deny-only boundary: the capability disposition ledger (repair-intelligence-phase0-capability-disposition.json), the deny-only capability contract (REPAIR_PHASE_NOT_ENABLED), and legacy evidence/OCR/byte-route containment. Domain steward: Repair Intelligence Governance; Security/IAM retains platform enforcement ownership.

changeControl.policy: A protocol or invariant change requires a versioned decision (ADR/design section) AND a migration/route-ledger reference. Implementation-only changes stay inside the owner boundary.

records.summary: KeyPurpose widened locally with TRUST_BUNDLE (Task 9) and EVIDENCE (Task 12) via documented casts; Task-1 contract untouched.
records.versionedDecision: design §11.2 KeyPurpose delta; SDD ledger Phase-B/C deltas

records.summary: Single mutable release authority (0182 release_revision via the V3 edge); legacy V1/V2 authority contained.
P2 plaintext readable only by the isolated workload identity; humans receive hashes/reports/evidence.

Added the SAFETY namespace to the §13 reason-code registry — SAFETY_CONTENT_REVOKED / SAFETY_CONTENT_BLOCKED / SAFETY_CONTENT_UNBLOCKED — for the deny-only content-revocation registry, mirrored into the factory-api edge transport with explicit 409 HTTP status (no 500 fallthrough). Additive vocabulary change; the existing 8 namespaces are intact. SQL raises these as bare string literals (no SQL enum).
